messages:
maria: Heads-up — quarterly access review is due next week. I started a quick pass on admin bindings and KMS grants; noticed a few cross-project keys still have broad 'admin' entries. Can we lock in owners and a cleanup plan? :eyes:

dan: thanks for flagging. can you share the query you used? i'll run it against prod audit logs and compare to last recert list.

maria: pasted the quick query I ran: ```sql
SELECT principal, role, resource, timestamp
FROM iam_audit
WHERE resource_type = 'kms_key'
  AND role LIKE '%admin%'
  AND timestamp > now() - interval '90 days'
ORDER BY resource, principal;
```

lee: fyi the KMS grants are sometimes granted via service_account groups that don't map cleanly to owners. we should also check service bindings in analytics and payments infra.

sasha: can we add a gating rule to the access-review runbook to require a justification note on any admin grant older than 30d? last time we removed some and people complained we didn't leave a trail. :grimacing:

nate: agree on justification. also proposing we create a temporary canary policy: when we revoke an admin grant, auto-add it to a 'temp-elevations' tracking label for 7 days and monitor for failing jobs or pager hits. rollback if any errors.

maria: good call. ops-bot can we wire a slack alert for any KMS-decrypt failures tied to revoked grants? ideally the alert links to the ticket and the previous owner.

audit-bot: auto-rule suggestion: add audit log filter 'kms:Decrypt' + 'principal NOT IN allowed_admins' and webhook to #eng-oncall for 72h after a revoke.

dan: i'll sketch the playbook steps: 1) generate owner map CSV (principal, team, last_active) 2) run KMS admin query + diff vs owner map 3) create PR to remove stale admin bindings with rollback labels 4) run canary revokes in staging 5) revoke in prod in 4-hour windows with ops monitoring.

lee: timeline? i can help with owner map, but need heads-up to contact teams for temp exceptions.

maria: propose timeline: owner map and audit queries by Tue EOD, canary revokes Wed morning on a low-traffic project, prod revokes Thu/Friday windows. owner outreach runs in parallel.

sasha: also add a KMS key policy review — ensure CMKs used by user-facing services are scoped to roles instead of broad service accounts. tiny change but big security win.

nate: question — do we want to rotate any keys as part of this? if we revoke and someone re-grants incorrectly, rotation forces re-eval but is noisier.

maria: let's avoid key rotation in this sweep unless we find compromised activity. keep it focused on entitlement cleanup + logging. we can schedule rotation separately.

dan: I'll add an audit checklist entry to the runbook: include a link to the exact query and the CSV diff, and require a sign-off from team lead before PR merge.

audit-bot: suggestion: tag PRs with label 'sec-audit:access-review-5423' and auto-check that sign-off from a lead exists before merging.

lee: one more operational ask — can we add a short retention policy to ensure the IAM audit logs used for the review are preserved for 180 days? currently some tables prune at 90d and that blocks historical recert.

maria: yes, i'll open a ticket to infra-logging to extend retention for the iam_audit table to 180d for the duration of the review.

sasha: action items rough list: maria -> owner map + queries; dan -> PR template + runbook update; lee -> owner outreach list; nate -> canary monitoring dashboard; audit-bot -> PR gating and alert hookup. i'll volunteer to do the key policy spot checks. :raised_hands:

maria: perfect. i'll assemble the owner CSV now and post results in this thread by EOD. thanks all. :thumbsup:

dan: thanks — ping me when owner CSV is up, i'll start the diffs.

nate: and i'll draft the rollback runbook for the canary window.

sasha: nice, feeling good about this approach. low-risk, observable, and documented.

maria: posted owner_map.csv link: https://redwood.internal/drive/owner_map_q2.csv — quick scan shows ~12 principals without clear owners, i'll annotate.

lee: saw the CSV. adding team contacts now.

audit-bot: reminder scheduled: weekly follow-up reminder in #eng-security for 2 weeks after revokes.

maria: thanks — i'll update the runbook and open the PR after we finish owner confirmations.

lee: thumbs up.

sasha: :rocket:
